summary.text: SIRKULERA MILJØ AS is a private limited company registered in Sandnes, founded 2012-04-01. Sirkulera Miljø AS registrert virksomhet omfatter innsamling av ikke-farlig avfall, sortering og bearbeiding av avfall for materialgjenvinning, kjøp, utvikling, utleie og salg av fast eiendom, entreprenørvirksomhet og transport. It was previously named ELTERVÅG AS until 2023-09-18. Its main industry code is 38.110: collection of non-hazardous waste. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 16 205 846 NOK and the annual result was 579 592 NOK; operating income was up from 11 190 672 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 108 134 NOK in 2024 to 579 592 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 376 527 NOK in 2024 to 956 119 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Knut Joar Eltervåg (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 18 on 2026-06-13 to 17 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
